scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Go, revise or stop
scenes.caption: Kabir brings the baseline plan, split audit, metrics, image-shift observations, source checks and model card to the review board. The recommendation must follow the evidence and name the human decision maker.
scenes.dialogue: What would make the decision change?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The pack is not ready for broad use
scenes.caption: The review-more result fits one cost plan, but alternative-format recall remains weak and changed image inputs are barely tested. A favourable overall number does not resolve those limitations. The manual staff route remains available.
scenes.dialogue: Meeting one criterion does not satisfy the whole brief.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Make a conditional recommendation
scenes.caption: A bounded go decision needs the stated criteria, safe scope and human oversight to hold. Revise when evidence or performance is insufficient. Stop the affected automatic workflow if it exposes private information or violates authority, and use an approved manual route.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the current recommendation
scenes.caption: Should Kabir approve broad use from ninety five percent, revise and independently retest the documented gaps while keeping the manual route, or delete the weak-group results?
scenes.dialogue: Keep inconvenient evidence in the pack.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: An accountable review
scenes.caption: Kabir recommends revision before broader use, identifies the missing evidence and assigns a staff review point. He also discloses any additional assistance used to prepare his explanation. A checked selection does not establish authorship or oral understanding.
scenes.dialogue: Defend the evidence and your contribution.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the review lab
scenes.caption: Assemble the assurance pack, recommend a bounded next step and respond to a fresh privacy failure. Explain when the non-AI baseline or manual route is preferable in an individual teacher-reviewed viva.
scenes.dialogue: A responsible recommendation includes a stop condition.
